name: Printful API
tagline: Print-on-demand fulfillment API for products, orders, and shipping
description: Printful provides a REST API for print-on-demand e-commerce: catalog and store product sync, order creation and fulfillment, shipping rates, mockup generation, file library, and webhooks. Developers authenticate with OAuth or private tokens and call HTTPS JSON endpoints to automate merch stores and custom product workflows.

auth.details: OAuth 2.0 access tokens (recommended) or private store tokens via Authorization: Bearer header; self-serve developer signup

use_cases: create a print-on-demand order for a custom t-shirt
list catalog products and variants with pricing
get shipping rates for a destination
sync store products and inventory with Printful
receive order status updates via webhooks
